name: Impose Condition
description: Forces a target to make a saving throw or suffer a condition, with no damage attached.

mechanics.text: On activation, a target that fails a saving throw suffers a condition — no damage involved at all (see feat.area-damage-burst/feat.extra-damage for the damage-bearing versions of this same save shape). Which condition, save ability/DC, and duration live in this record's own featureParams.
